title: Question 22
passage:
Would you like one receipt for the whole team or separate receipts?
A. There are six of us today. B. One is fine. We’ll file it together. C. We booked that table on Monday.
passageZh:
你想要整個團隊開一張收據，還是分開開？
A. 我們今天有六個人。 B. 一張就好。我們會一起歸檔。 C. 那張桌子是我們星期一訂的。
